import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
print(df[cands].describe().T[['mean','std','min','max']])
# steps_k detail
d = df.dropna(subset=['recovery_score','steps_k'])
m = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k + C(hospital)', data=d).fit()
print(m.params)
print('p', m.pvalues['steps_k'])
# robust
mr = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k + C(hospital)', data=d).fit(cov_type='HC3')
print('HC3 p', mr.pvalues['steps_k'])

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
d = df.dropna(subset=['recovery_score']).copy()
# add steps_k squared to test nonlinearity
d2 = d.dropna(subset=['steps_k'])
d2['steps_k2']=d2['steps_k']**2
m = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k + steps_k2 + C(hospital)', data=d2).fit()
print('steps_k', m.pvalues['steps_k'], 'steps_k2', m.pvalues['steps_k2'])
# bootstrap p for steps_k
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
base = smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k + C(hospital)', data=d2).fit()
tobs = base.tvalues['steps_k']
cnt=0
for _ in range(2000):
    dd=d2.copy()
    dd['recovery_score']=rng.permutation(dd['recovery_score'].values)
    t=smf.ols('recovery_score ~ steps_k + C(hospital)', data=dd).fit().tvalues['steps_k']
    if abs(t)>=abs(tobs): cnt+=1
print('perm p', cnt/2000)
